title: 翻译练习 · 卢沟桥（Lugou Bridge）
source_cn: 卢沟桥（Lugou Bridge）位于北京西南15公里处，始建于1189年，距今已有800多年的历史。桥上建有大量雕刻精美、形态各异的石狮子，因此民间有“卢沟桥的狮子——数不清”的歇后语。这座桥不仅以其建筑艺术闻名，也因1937年发生的“卢沟桥事变”而具有重要历史意义。
ref_en: Lugou Bridge is located about 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing. First built in 1189, it has a history of over 800 years. The bridge is decorated with a great number of exquisitely carved stone lions in various postures, which gave rise to the folk simile "the lions on Lugou Bridge — too many to count." The bridge is famous not only for its architectural art but also for its historic significance, as the Lugou Bridge Incident took place there in 1937.
